title: fix(console): a declared same-origin `type: 'api'` click goes through the action door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台里点击「对象上声明过、目标是本站路径的 `type: 'api'` 动作」（列表行、工具栏、页面按钮、记录页抬头和相关列表）时，不再由浏览器直接请求动作的 target，而是发到平台动作门 `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action`，只带记录 id 和参数，由服务端按声明组装请求再转发。目标在其他域名的 api 动作、没有对应声明的页面内联按钮、不挂在对象上的全局动作，仍然直连。
- 为什么改：这是 #27506 裁定「agent 和人类使用同一套系统」的第 3 步。之前人点按钮绕过了服务端的登录底线、requiredPermissions、启用开关和参数契约：在 Setup 关掉一个打包的 api 动作，按钮照样能执行。现在关掉的动作点下去返回 409 ACTION_DISABLED，界面显示那句说明，目标不会被调用。
- 风险与回滚：所有声明式同源 api 动作（邀请成员、封禁用户、审批同意/驳回、轮换密钥等）的请求路径都变了。服务端动作门目前有两个缺口（#27738）：丢掉目标错误里的 details/userMessage，以及拒收审批决策的 `outputs.<key>` 参数。在 #27738 合入之前合本 PR，会让「带决策输出的审批」被拒、套餐升级弹窗缺链接、流程端点的拒绝提示退回节点链。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/apiActionDoor.ts`（选门规则、发送与 2xx 读取）；`hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` 的 apiHandler 动作门分支；`views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 的 apiHandler 动作门分支。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/apiActionDoor.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.apiActionDoor-27611.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.apiActionDoor-27611.test.tsx`，预期 3 个文件 25 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。合并顺序是 #27738 在前、本 PR 在后，本 PR 已标 Blocked-by。

Fixes #27611
Blocked-by: #27738
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Step 3 of the ruling on #27506: a person's click and an agent's `run_action` take the same road. The server half is on `main` (#27649: the action door accepts a declared `type: 'api'` action whose `target` is a path on this origin, runs its gates and forwards to the target in-process). This PR moves the console's two api handlers onto it.

- **New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/apiActionDoor.ts`** (module-internal, not re-exported):
  - `isSameOriginApiTarget` restates the server's predicate (`action-execution.ts#isSameOriginApiTarget`): a path that starts with one `/`, not `//` or `/\`.
  - `findDeclaredApiAction(objects, objectName, actionName, clickedTarget)` decides the door by lookup, as `flowLaunch` looks up a flow action: the click's object and `name` must resolve to a declared `type: 'api'` action whose declared `target` is same-origin and is the clicked target. A `${…}` token the runner already interpolated into the target matches one path segment.
  - `sendApiActionThroughDoor` sends through `@object-ui/core`'s `createServerActionHandler`, so the `/actions` request (name-only identity, `{ recordId, params }`, the `_rowRecord` strip) stays core's and app-shell still names that route nowhere (`actions-envelope.ratchet.test.ts`). It keeps the raw answer for the host to read.
  - `readApiActionDoorSuccess` reads a 2xx through the `/actions` envelope rule (`interpretActionResponse`). The door answers the target's payload as its `data`, already unwrapped from the target's `{ success, data }`, so the payload is what the direct fetch handed back for a target that answers bare (a stock better-auth body), and a target's HTTP 200 rejection relayed inside `data` reads as a failure.
- **`useConsoleActionRuntime` `apiHandler`** (list rows, toolbar, page actions): for a same-origin target with an object and a name it waits for the object type (as the flow launch does, so "no declaration" is an answer and not a race against a cold store), looks the action up, and on a hit sends `{ recordId: <stashed row's id>, params: <params, {{page.<var>}} resolved> }` to the door. A non-2xx goes through the same reader as the direct fetch (`refused`: the entitlement dialog, then `apiActionFailureMessage`). A 2xx returns the payload and honours `refreshAfter`.
- **`RecordDetailView` `apiHandler`** (record header, related lists): the same, looked up in the page's `objects`. The subject id is the stashed row's id, else a related-list row's explicit `recordId`, else this page's id when the action is on this page's object. A non-2xx reads `apiActionFailureMessage` as the direct fetch does, and `refreshAfter === true` keeps this page's meaning. The edit stays inside `apiHandler`, plus its import line and `objects` in its dependency list.
- The direct fetch is unchanged for an off-origin target, for a click that names no declared action (an inline page `action:button`), and for a declared action the lookup cannot see (below). `withNewTabUrlFastPath` still wraps both handlers, so a `newTabUrl` click sends nothing on either road.
- The six docblock and pin sites that quoted the superseded ADR-0066 D4 text now read the amended D4 (the action door dispatches a declared same-origin api action and runs its `requiredPermissions`; an off-origin target never reaches it): `containers.tsx`, `action-bar.test.tsx`, `page-header-capability-gate.test.tsx`, `bulkActionCapabilityGate.test.tsx`, `plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, `RelatedList.toolbarCapabilityGate-9782.test.tsx`.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Tests

New:

- `utils/__tests__/apiActionDoor.test.ts` (6): the predicate on every spelling the server's predicate answers; the lookup by object, name, type and target, an interpolated `${ctx.recordId}` target, and no hit for an off-origin declaration, another type, another target, or a missing object, name or metadata.
- `hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.apiActionDoor-27611.test.tsx` (12), on the hook's real `apiHandler`:
  - door road: the request is `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_user/ban_user` with `{ recordId, params }` and nothing reaches the target; `409 ACTION_DISABLED` answers its sentence, never the bare code; a 2xx answers the unwrapped payload and refreshes; a relayed 200 rejection is a failure and does not refresh; `{{page.<var>}}` tokens arrive resolved in `params`.
  - direct road: an off-origin target; a click that names no declared action; a same-named declaration aimed at another target.
  - written against what the door answers once #27738 lands: a flow-backed endpoint's `FLOW_FAILED` reads its inner refusal (the form's permission line); `DEV_ENV_PLAN_LOCKED` opens the upgrade dialog with its call to action and no error toast; `DEV_ENV_LIMIT` quotes the usage; an approval decision sends `outputs.<key>` as params.
- `views/RecordDetailView.apiActionDoor-27611.test.tsx` (7), on the handler set the record page hands its `ActionProvider`: a header click sends this page's id and hands back the target's payload; a bare target answer comes back at the level the direct fetch handed back, so a `resultDialog` path (`client_secret`) still reads; a relayed 200 rejection is a failure; `409 ACTION_DISABLED` answers its sentence; a related-list child row sends the child row's id to the child object's door; an off-origin target goes direct; the `FLOW_FAILED` inner refusal once #27738 lands.

Updated, because they pinned the direct target URL of a DECLARED same-origin action, which now goes through the door (each now pins the door route and its body): `RecordDetailView.approvalDeclaredActions.test.tsx` (the decision goes to `/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_send_back` with the request's id; the output rides as `outputs.next_reviewer` in `params`), `RecordDetailView.accessEndedAfterDecision-26589.test.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.apiNewTabUrl-26747.test.tsx` (CONTROL), `RecordDetailView.printPageHeaderActions-12906.test.tsx` (c), `PageView.relatedListActions-12870.test.tsx`, `ObjectView.inviteFeedback-11817.test.tsx`, and `apps/console/.../approvalRequestsDataSource.decisionPage.test.tsx`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Blocked by #27738.** On the door road, three answers lose what the direct fetch kept until #27738 lands: the door drops the target's `error.details` and `userMessage` (a flow-backed endpoint's refusal shows the node chain again; an entitlement 403 loses its upgrade/contact links, plan and usage), and the door's param contract refuses an approval decision's `outputs.<key>` params (`approval_approve` / `approval_reject` declare `comment` and `attachments`), so a decision with declared outputs is refused 400. The four pins in the "once #27738 lands" group are written against the door's answer after that change and are shown here only against a mocked door.
- **The `outputs.*` fold moved to the server.** The console now sends `outputs.<key>` as params and the door's `buildApiActionRequest` folds them into `outputs`. No server test pins that fold today; #27738 is the place to add one.
- **"Same body as before" is pinned in two halves.** The console side pins the same inputs (the subject row's id and the params bag) against a mocked door. The body the door assembles from them (`recordIdParam` / `recordIdField`, `bodyShape.wrap`, `bodyExtra`, `method`, the target's placeholders, `organizationId`) is pinned server-side in `packages/runtime/src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts`.
- **What the lookup cannot see keeps the direct fetch.** The lookup reads the object metadata the host holds, as the flow launch does. An object-less declared action (`/actions/global/:action`) and a standalone authored action row no object embeds are absent from it, so their click stays direct and their switch does not hold on a click. Noted, not filed.
- **Edges that differ on the door road, by reading the code (not reproduced):**
  - `organizationId` for an `/api/v1/auth/` target now comes from the server's execution context rather than the browser's active organization.
  - A target that answers HTTP 200 `{ success: false, data: … }` loses its rejection at the door (`apiActionResultOf` hands back `data`), and a 200 `{ success: false, message }` with keys outside the legacy envelope reads as success under the narrow `/actions` rule. The direct fetch caught both through `success === false`. No producer of either shape was measured.
  - A `{{page.<var>}}` token with no page-variable snapshot is sent as-is; the door refuses it 400, where the direct fetch sent it to the target literally.
  - On the record page, a 2xx now hands back the payload unwrapped from the target's `{ success, data }` (the list runtime's level), where the direct fetch handed back the envelope; a bare answer is unchanged, and a relayed 200 rejection is now a failure there too.
- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` already describes the door for declared same-origin api actions; no docs change.
- Sibling #27504 (the switched-off button's visibility) is not in this PR.

## Verification

- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, marker `'ABLATED_27611'` making `findDeclaredApiAction` answer no declaration, so every click takes the direct fetch): on the 3 new files, 17 red (every door-road case in both hosts and the two positive lookup cases), 8 green (the four direct-road controls and the predicate and negative lookup cases); on the 10-file set, 27 red including every updated pin. Restore: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. Two door pins that stayed green on the first ablation (they read the same answer on both roads) now also assert the door road.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`) on `b6ee6801`: 34 derived, 34 run, all exit 0 (including `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and its `--self-test`, and `check:nul-bytes`); `--ran` reconciliation: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
